comment: Ground truth for the user's own library (established by ear + analysis). Values are DETECTOR-relative: rot = allowed values of (downbeat index % beatsPerBar) on the detector's own beat grid; bpb = expected beatsPerBar. null = no stable ground truth, report only. reject:true = the detector must return null (no steady pulse deserves a metronome).

Mr Crowley.note: slip-class: no stable rotation GT; anchor pins the user-lived-with v6 grid so fill regressions cannot slip through as report-only
